influences.name: Mike Cave
influences.context: He was the best person to meet at that time because he was so positive, reassuring, and levelheaded. He was amazing—so inspiring. I was very lucky to meet him at that time... I'd spend the day in his studio prepping his mixes, and then I'd watch him mix. I learned so much from him.

influences.name: Tim Oliver

influences.name: Jimi Hendrix
influences.context: In 2016, Blake revealed that a primary inspiration for his live performances was the Jimi Hendrix live album Band of Gypsys (1970), stating that "I want to be that. It's so free."

influences.name: gospel records
influences.context: That feeling is akin to my favorite gospel records, where people are all in a room clapping, singing and shouting.

influences.name: Hip-hop and R&B
influences.context: Hip-hop and R&B are the big influences for me. I think I hear it in a way I can work with.

influences.name: Leonard Cohen
influences.context: Single 'Death Of Love' is a marvellous piece of work – part flamenco, Gnawa and alternative R&B, with a Leonard Cohen sample from 'You Want It Darker' sung by a Welsh choir.

influences.name: Thee Sinseers
influences.context: James delivered a boss performance of 'I Had A Dream She Took My Hand' on Jimmy Fallon, a track that contains a rather brilliant sample from East LA outfit Thee Sinseers. 'They are a wonderful band', James declares. 'I love them'

influences.name: Valerie Armstrong

influences.name: Doctor Who soundtrack
influences.context: That voice, in a way, is to AI music what the Doctor Who soundtrack is to the way I make electronic music.
